Review.signature: Review(main: Main, chain: Chain, moments: MomentCard[], mine?: ForYou)
Review.description: The whole Разбор tab: Main, then Chain, then three MomentCards (the three moments, any order), then ForYou.

Main.signature: Main(line: string, picture: BkbPicture | GoldPicture | LeadPicture | VisionPicture | DeathsPicture | FightFrame, fights?: string[])
Main.description: The first screen: `line` is one sentence on why this match was lost (decision, not person, contrast what was done and what should have been), `picture` is the one picture that shows it best, `fights` are 2-3 fight ids shown as proof chips.

BkbPicture.description: Timeline of when each hero of both teams bought BKB, with the three main fights marked. For matches decided by BKB timings (signals bkb).

GoldPicture.description: Net worth difference per minute, your lead above zero, enemy lead below. For matches decided by farm (signals nw).

LeadPicture.description: Win chance curve with its peak and the fall after it. For a won position that was lost (signals lead).

VisionPicture.description: Wards of both teams and, for the fights where vision cost chance, how many enemies each side saw. For matches lost in the dark (signals vision).

DeathsPicture.description: Every time a hero died shortly before a fight and was not back for it, on the match timeline. For matches lost by feeding before fights (signals deaths).

FightFrame.description: Minimap at the first second of main fight `fight` (one of the moments ids): where all ten heroes stood and what was ready. For a match one fight decided.

Chain.description: The chain of causes across the match: 3-5 ChainLinks, drawn in time order on the match timeline; each opens its fight.

ChainLink.description: One link of the match chain by its id ("c4") and a short phrase, up to 12 words, that ties it to the next link.

MomentCard.description: Card of one main fight (a moments id). `show` lists the proofs in the order to show them: replay (minimap replay), ready (ultimates, BKB, TP ready at the first second), whatif (only if the fight has whatif), concepts (team facts), deaths (heroes dead before it). `note` is one short line, contrast done -> should have done.

ForYou.description: Habits block: for each of your heroes that has habits, the one or two habits that matter most. The reader picks the hero.

Habit.signature: Habit(slot: number, key: string, note?: string)
Habit.description: One habit of hero `slot` against pro by its key from habits (lh_pm, deaths, wards); note is one short line for that hero.

componentGroups.name: Pictures for Main
